import csv
occ_id='fb91b6fa-b336-5d94-a6fe-e00343bc30a9'
pw_id='1b318110-05c1-54b3-8fea-315f5900b64a'
occ={}
pw={}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.reader(f)
    header=next(r)
    for row in r:
        tsid,ts,val=row[0],row[1],row[2]
        if tsid==occ_id:
            occ[ts]=val
        elif tsid==pw_id:
            pw[ts]=val
print(len(occ),len(pw))
# filter date
date='2018-07-23'
common=[t for t in occ if t.startswith(date) and t in pw]
print('common rows', len(common))
count=0
for t in sorted(common):
    o=float(occ[t]); p=float(pw[t])
    # lights on if p>1, unoccupied if o==0
    on = p>1
    unocc = o==0
    # print sample
    if on and unocc:
        count+=1
print('count', count)
# check distinct values occupancy
print(set(float(v) for v in occ.values()))
print('power sample', sorted(float(v) for v in pw.values())[:10])

import csv
occ_id='fb91b6fa-b336-5d94-a6fe-e00343bc30a9'
pw_id='1b318110-05c1-54b3-8fea-315f5900b64a'
occ={}; pw={}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.reader(f); next(r)
    for row in r:
        if row[0]==occ_id: occ[row[1]]=row[2]
        elif row[0]==pw_id: pw[row[1]]=row[2]
date='2018-07-23'
for t in sorted(t for t in occ if t.startswith(date)):
    print(t, occ[t], pw[t])
